title: A Quantitative Framework for Estimating System Complexity and Cost via Component Interface Analysis
title_zh: 通过组件接口分析估计系统复杂度与成本的定量框架
abstract_en: This paper introduces a formal modeling framework designed to estimate the complexity and cost associated with system changes induced by external requirements. We model a system as a directed graph of couplings, capturing the intricate dependencies and information flows between components and elements within a specific context. The proposed method enables the estimation of bounded change complexity through component interfaces, even when internal logic remains opaque. Additionally, the framework provides a mechanism for bounding the cost of system-wide modifications by associating external drivers and cost factors with individual system elements. We propose a multi-view approach to the model, providing graphical, algebraic, and tabular representations to suit different levels of abstraction and computational needs. By bridging the gap between component-based modeling and project cost estimation, our method provides actionable insights for architecture design, software engineering, and lifecycle operations. The model is validated through a case study involving the integration of a sample retail banking platform.
abstract_zh: 本文提出一个形式化建模框架，用于估计由外部需求触发的系统变更所带来的复杂度与成本。该方法将系统建模为耦合关系的有向图，以刻画特定上下文中组件与元素之间的依赖关系和信息流。即使组件内部逻辑不可见，框架也可通过组件接口估计有界的变更复杂度。同时，它将外部驱动因素与成本因子关联到单个系统元素，从而为全系统修改成本提供上界估计。论文采用多视图建模方式，提供图形、代数和表格表示，以适应不同抽象层级和计算需求。通过连接组件化建模与项目成本估算，该方法可为架构设计、软件工程和生命周期运维提供可操作的分析依据，并通过一个示例零售银行平台集成案例进行验证。
key_points_zh: 将系统表示为耦合关系的 directed graph，用于描述组件间依赖、接口交互和信息流。
在组件内部逻辑不透明的情况下，通过 component interface analysis 估计有界变更复杂度。
将 external drivers 与 cost factors 映射到系统元素，以推导系统级修改成本的上界。
提供 graphical、algebraic、tabular 三种视图，兼顾架构理解、形式化计算与工程落地。
通过 sample retail banking platform 集成案例验证框架在软件工程与成本估算中的适用性。

llm_assessment.comment: The work is a generic system complexity and cost modeling framework with almost no meaningful grounding in e-commerce agents or shopping/search/recommendation systems.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该工作主要是通用系统复杂度与成本建模框架，几乎没有体现电商智能体、购物、搜索或推荐系统价值。
